name: CA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Post-redistricting D+7 fundamentals strongly favor Democrats
Prediction markets price the race near 96% Democratic
McGuire out-raises Gallagher and holds an outside-spending edge
No public polling; incumbency is Gallagher's main asset
model.rationale: The redrawn district's Democratic lean and a favorable environment outweigh Gallagher's incumbency, markets price the race at roughly 96% Democratic, and McGuire holds a modest fundraising and outside-support edge.
model.watch: Any polling showing Gallagher near parity, or a national environment shifting toward Republicans, would move this rating.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
The seat was redrawn to favor Democrats by seven points, and the broader environment adds several more, giving the fundamentals a strongly Democratic tilt. Republican incumbent James Gallagher is running, and his incumbency is worth a couple of points, but it does not come close to offsetting the new partisan geography. No public polls cover the contest, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing.

Prediction markets put Democratic chances near 96 percent, and Democrat Mike McGuire has slightly out-raised Gallagher while drawing more than $600,000 in outside support. Cash on hand is similar for the two candidates. The forecast expects McGuire to win by roughly 17 points, a Safe Democratic rating, though the lack of polling keeps uncertainty wider than usual.
